name: @seneca/transport-test
description: Standard test cases for Seneca transports.

scripts.coverage: lab -c -r console -o stdout -r html -o coverage.html test/lab.test.js
scripts.repo-tag: REPO_VERSION=`node -e "console.log(require('./package').version)"` && echo TAG: v$REPO_VERSION && git commit -a -m v$REPO_VERSION && git push && git tag v$REPO_VERSION && git push --tags;
scripts.repo-publish: npm run repo-tag && npm publish --access public --registry http://registry.npmjs.org

author: Richard Rodger (http://richardrodger.com)
